decision: Native contextual capability first; no new external runtime dependency or top-level workflow section in the initial proposal.

packages.title: Boundary and model-contract review
packages.deliverable: Current native workflow/input ownership and fidelity contract, with fit gates; no new engine selection.

packages.title: Trace and cohort artifacts
packages.deliverable: Reuse the assumed envelope; optional bounded authorized event trace and planning references. Detailed cohorts only when needed.

packages.title: Active buffer and native-frequency screening
packages.deliverable: Energy-conserving target/achieved PoC comparison; omitted metrics unknown.

packages.title: One external electrical-engine spike
packages.deliverable: Only after fit gates: a supplied, source-backed physical model for an explicit specialist requirement; no default engine committed.

packages.title: Optional workload/controller coupling
packages.deliverable: Only for a validated computing-service question; local data and native project continuity, no mandatory second coordinator.

packages.title: Reserve/aging and planning feedback
packages.deliverable: Dispatch-state-bound constraints/costs with declared local validity and explicit proposed apply.

packages.title: Workflow, comparison and evidence integration
packages.deliverable: Optional contextual inputs/results in existing flow, no engine picker or mandatory extra setup; preserve run-readiness and evidence.

conditional_dependencies.GTR-04: Needs the validated screening/electrical model contract used for its claimed outputs; no direct dependency on a particular optional engine.
conditional_dependencies.GTR-05: Requires GTR-03/04 evidence if feedback claims those detailed/coupled capabilities.
conditional_dependencies.GTR-06: First release is screen-only; later detailed result views depend on passed GTR-03.
